text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you going out today, Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm taking a trip to Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, otherwise known as the Empress, is Fine Motion's roommate.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Kyoto?! How splendid! Are you making the trip to taste their udon?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm not nearly the gourmand that you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm going to spectate a G1 race—The Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, I've never seen it in person. Is that race special to you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's one of the most important races in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's a noble and honorable race… One that demands the utmost respect.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Just running there is something to be proud of. And then, you can feel the deep respect the crowd has for the one who wins it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I've run there before. It was a bitter defeat, but still a beautiful memory for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Even now, I can vividly recall how I felt, vying for victory in that race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: They're broadcasting the race on TV as well, so you should watch it. It's quite the stately and elegant affair, so I imagine you'd find it interesting.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Right, well, I'm off now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Wait, Groove!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Bring me back something salty, okay? ♪ See you when you get back!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …So, would you like to watch the Queen Elizabeth II Cup with me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's settled, then! Hehe, I'm so excited! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so we watch the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, which turns into a truly intense battle!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What drive! What passion! This is turning into the fight of the season! And… three racers have crossed the finish line simultaneously! It's a photo finish!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd in the stands erupts as the Umamusume cross the finish line together, almost as if it had been planned in advance.

text_block_list.name: Cheers from the TV
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What an exquisite race!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Everyone was truly remarkable. Their desire for victory was positively palpable.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I was only watching, but my heart was in my throat the whole time.
choice_data_list: Sounds like their desire was infectious.
Sounds like their desire was infectious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One can't hope to enter a G1 race with just ordinary effort. All the hardest-working racers gather at those races, and only one can claim first place.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove said that she remembers running there vividly even now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup… There's something special about it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The desire for victory…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion quietly mutters these words. However, I'm unable to read exactly what emotion is welling up within her.
